# UltraHive

> UltraHive is a premium hexagonal falling-block puzzle by Ripsaw LLC. $2.99 once on the App Store and $2.99 once on Google Play. Each store sells it separately. No ads and no in-app purchases.

Pieces drop onto a neon 11-column honeycomb and rotate in 60-degree steps. A hold piece and a ghost preview are included. Color chains of 10 or more cells clear. Classic mode has 25 intensity levels and five power-ups: place anywhere, clear a row, slow time, flip gravity, and shrink to a single hex. Hive Bits is 28 handcrafted puzzles with walls, moths, bee allies, and honey.

The iOS app launched on 2026-02-24. Version 1.7 was released on 2026-11-15. Game Center is used for leaderboards only. On Apple, one purchase covers iPhone, iPad, Mac with Apple Silicon, and Apple Vision Pro, and Family Sharing is available. The Google Play purchase is separate. Android has been on Google Play since 2026-09-10 and is fully offline. Scores and coins stay on the device. UltraHive does not collect personal data.

No rating, review count, award, or download total is stated on this site.

Most of the code was written with AI assistance (Claude Code). Game design, testing and tuning are by the developer, David Kon / Ripsaw LLC. The build note is at https://ultrahive.app/made-with-claude-code/. It does not state an origin for the art.

UltraHive is not affiliated with or endorsed by The Tetris Company. Tetris is a trademark of The Tetris Holding, LLC.

- [How to play](https://ultrahive.app/how-to-play/): Rules for rotation, clears, power-ups, and Hive Bits. Also tips for chain clears (10 or more connected cells of the same color; cascading clears multiply the score), the 15 hex pieces from monohex to pentahex, and how the honeycomb differs from a square falling-block grid
- [Press kit](https://ultrahive.app/press/): Facts, screenshots, and contact for reviewers
- [Privacy policy](https://ultrahive.app/privacy/): No personal data collection. Canonical privacy URL
- [Hexagonal games like Tetris](https://ultrahive.app/hexagonal-tetris-games/): Comparison of hexagon block puzzles. UltraHive is our game. Other rows use only facts from each game's official page. No ratings or download counts
- [Best hexagonal block puzzle games](https://ultrahive.app/best-hexagonal-block-puzzle-games/): Falling-block hex puzzles and drag-and-drop hex puzzles. UltraHive is our game. Other entries use only the facts stated on the page. No ratings or download counts
- [No ads](https://ultrahive.app/no-ads-puzzle-game/): $2.99 once on the App Store and $2.99 once on Google Play, sold separately. No ads and no in-app purchases. Android is fully offline. On iOS the game plays offline and Game Center is for leaderboards only
- [Strategy](https://ultrahive.app/strategy/): Scoring table, combo, multi-chain and perfect-clear bonuses, drop speed at each of the 25 levels, and tips
- [Pieces](https://ultrahive.app/pieces/): All 15 pieces by size, shape and color: 1 monohex, 1 dihex, 2 trihexes, 6 tetrahexes, 5 pentahexes
- [Power-ups](https://ultrahive.app/power-ups/): Slow 60 coins, Tiny 80, Place 100, Flip 120, Clear 150. One coin per 100 points. Coins cannot be bought
- [Hive Bits](https://ultrahive.app/hive-bits/): The 28 puzzle levels in six chapters, and what honey, walls, bee eggs, moth eggs, magic honey and holes do
- [Games without ads](https://ultrahive.app/games-without-ads/): How to check a game's store listing for ads on Google Play and the App Store
- [No wifi games](https://ultrahive.app/no-wifi-games/): Why some games need a connection, how to test one in airplane mode, and how UltraHive plays offline
- [Games like Tetris](https://ultrahive.app/games-like-tetris/): The kinds of falling-block puzzle and what a hexagonal grid changes
- [Changelog](https://ultrahive.app/changelog/): Version history
- [About](https://ultrahive.app/about/): Developer David Kon, publisher Ripsaw LLC, key facts, contact
